messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — noticed per-token cost on /generate routes jumped ~18% after yesterday's kernel selection tweak.

ton y: Interesting. Any correlation with KV hit rate? We changed fallback kernel heuristics at 03:10.

maya: Yeah KV misses spiked from 2.5% -> 9% for one heavy route (session-history enabled). Logs show more seq-level evictions.

liam: Can you paste the sample log? Also do we map KV misses into token accounting right now?

maya: Here's a clipped log:

```
[2026-03-18T03:12:41Z] req=abcd123 route=/generate model=redwood-v1 kernel=fast-attn kv_hit=false tokens=128 kernel_ms=42
[2026-03-18T03:12:41Z] req=abcd123 span=svc.infer kv_evict=true
```

maya: Current billing uses token.processed_total by route/model but doesn't attribute extra kernel time due to KV misses — so unit economics look better than reality.

nora: Oof. That explains the discrepancy on the econ dashboard. Our per-token latency panel shows 12ms median but infra billing shows higher GPU minutes.

sam: Proposal: add two metrics: token.kv_miss_count{route,model,version} and token.kernel_ms_total{route,model,version}. Use kernel_ms_total/token.processed_total = avg kernel ms per token.

tony: Agree. Also tag kernel.variant and kv_path (prefix vs attention-cache) so we can slice by kernel selection.

liam: We'll need low-overhead instrumentation. Suggest sample 1/10 tokens for kernel_ms and full counts for kv_miss; or use micro-timers in runtime that aggregate per-batch.

nora: On dashboard side: new panels — 1) avg kernel ms per token by route (last 7d) 2) kv miss rate vs kernel ms heatmap 3) per-route cost delta (billing vs measured compute)

maya: Can someone own a short RFC? I'll collect sample traces and kernel profiles from the 03:10 rollout.

sam: I'll wire metrics into Flightdeck as new series and add a per-route KPI. I'll do a canary for 2 hours.

tony: FYI @deploy-bot we've scheduled a canary rollout for the metric patch at 10:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: build 2026.03.18-064 deployed to staging — metrics pipeline ok :white_check_mark:

liam: After canary, we should run a reconciliation job to compare billed GPU-seconds per-customer vs measured kernel_ms_total converted to GPU-seconds using kernel_profiles.

maya: Sounds good — I'll draft RFC and include cost formulas. tl;dr: Align billing-facing metrics with per-token kernel accounting + kv-miss surcharge.

nora: Nice. If we get this right, will fix the unit economics dashboards and reduce the silent margin drift.

sam: Punting infra-level microcost estimation to follow-up, but the immediate win is token.kv_miss and kernel_ms.

maya: Thanks all — assigning owners in RFC. I'll ping once draft is ready :rocket:
